authority: Future session must select a finite batch explicitly; this inventory performs no acquisition.

worlds.atelier: Atelier: warm walnut drafting desk, brushed metal lamp, linen and cream paper, evening amber light; tactile and quiet, not luxury-office photography.
worlds.arcade: Arcade: an original indigo arcade workshop with cyan cabinet light, restrained violet trim and abstract horizon graphics; no game logos, screen text or recognizable cabinets.
worlds.sakura: Sakura: an original plum-and-rose illustration room with a distant blossom courtyard, dark ink timber and a few drifting petals; restrained botanical atmosphere.
worlds.retro-anime: Retro Anime / Night Shift: an original late-night animation workshop above a rain-washed city; soft CRT light, distant rail line, rose/cyan reflections, warm desk lamp and a quiet text-safe wall. Quiet Morning keeps the camera and architecture.
worlds.minimal-pro: Minimal Pro: graphite architectural surfaces, ivory paper and diffuse daylight; almost monochrome, precise and calm, with no character or neon decoration.
worlds.sci-fi-noir: Sci-Fi Noir: an original observatory workshop with architectural shadows, weathered steel and a remote orbital horizon; muted blue-grey with a small warm instrument glow.
worlds.shared: Shared functional language: original geometric folio, frame, light and star motifs; neutral line work with replaceable theme accents. All real labels and state semantics stay in HTML.

scene.master: 3840x2160 landscape target; confirm actual provider size support before generation.
deliverables: Composition notes and normalized focal point
scene.safe_zone: Keep the middle-left 60% low-detail and low-contrast. Main interest lives near the right edge; allow 12% crop overscan.
scene.fallback: CSS token surface until an accepted local poster exists.
scene.budget: Runtime preview <=300 KiB; master retained outside the runtime bundle.
scene.motion: Still. No status text, UI buttons, glyphs or logos.

hero.master: 3840x1600 wide crop/extension target from the approved scene, not an unrelated composition.
hero.safe_zone: Left 60% for real HTML heading. Protect focal subject at normalized x=.78; never crop essential anatomy.
hero.fallback: Accepted local poster then token-only header.

wall.master: 2400x1600 panel-wall adaptation target from the approved master.
wall.safe_zone: Central 70% quiet; edge motifs only. No fake gauges, chart values or active controls.
wall.motion: Still; texture must not reduce text contrast.

quiet.master: 3840x2160 edit target, same lens/architecture as scene anchor.
quiet.safe_zone: Preserve anchor focal zones and silhouette positions; quiet must not look like an error.
quiet.motion: Still; offline-capable, also selectable while connected.

poster.master: Extract a representative frame/crop from the approved scene or loop; do not generate independently.
poster.safe_zone: Match the loop camera and object placement so fallback does not jump.
poster.fallback: Theme token surface with unchanged layout.
poster.motion: Still, suitable for reduced motion and active generation.

layer.master: 3840x2160 aligned RGBA target, matching the scene canvas; include hidden-background repair.
deliverables: Layer transform origin, depth order and coverage notes
layer.safe_zone: 12% overscan; aligned pixel coordinates and shared vanishing point; no baked checkerboard.
layer.budget: Runtime layer <=220 KiB; at most three active layers; measure decoded memory.
layer.motion: Future transform-only displacement 2/4/6 px; off for reduced motion/coarse pointers.

loop.master: 6-10 second fixed-camera video target from the approved anchor; 1920x1080 preferred when supported.
deliverables: Loop seam comparison and motion mask notes
loop.safe_zone: No movement behind text-safe zones; only environmental rain/light/distant motion. No camera cuts or UI-like progress.
loop.fallback: Matching local poster is required before activation.
loop.budget: Runtime loop <=4 MiB; one decorative video maximum.
loop.motion: No audio track; no flashes; user pause; pause while jobs active/uncertain or tab hidden.

card.master: 1024x1024 square crop target of accepted scene; retain a distinct silhouette.
card.safe_zone: No text; tiny-size contrast and coherent crop across skins.
card.fallback: Theme swatch plus HTML skin name.

workflow.master: 1200x900 original conceptual vignette, consistent camera and accent family.
workflow.safe_zone: Simple silhouette and quiet lower third for HTML caption; never depict a fake successful output.
workflow.fallback: Semantic icon plus real task name.
workflow.motion: Still; later tutorial is a separate real capture.

empty.master: 768x512 isolated original geometric illustration on true alpha.
deliverables: Alt/caption recommendation based on actual placement
empty.safe_zone: No text, sad/error anthropomorphism or hidden instructions. State remains an HTML label.
empty.motion: Still by default; no looping loading spin baked into an image.

reference.master: 1024x1024 or 1024x1536 canonical original example target depending on subject.
reference.safe_zone: Clear subject; neutral framing; no template lettering. Any person is an original adult.
reference.motion: Still; not a biometric or pose-accuracy claim.

foundation.master: Editable code/vector source, not a generated raster image.
foundation.safe_zone: Do not encode labels, state or focus rings into raster art.
foundation.budget: Measure actual source/build cost; no image payload required.
foundation.motion: CSS/WAAPI only when needed; immediate reduced-motion alternative.

guide.master: 768x768 original nonhuman folio-and-star companion, true alpha, consistent silhouette.
guide.safe_zone: No speech baked into art. Do not sit over buttons or validation. Avoid visual age/sexualization ambiguity by using a nonhuman motif.
guide.fallback: Small abstract accent or no companion.
guide.motion: Still; optional expression transition, never required to understand help.

tutorial.master: Actual UI recording after the named workflow exists and is qualified; target 1280x720.
deliverables: Poster, exact app commit and synthetic/public fixture provenance
tutorial.safe_zone: No private prompts, paths, tokens or user images; pointer/focus must be readable at half size.
tutorial.budget: Target <=8 MiB per clip; lazy-load after explicit play.
tutorial.motion: Record the real UI. No generated fake software demonstration or claimed inference.

promo.master: 2400x1260 original marketing composition target or truthful assembled product capture.
deliverables: Master with separate editable text layer
promo.safe_zone: Reserve left 55% for typeset copy; examples clearly labelled; no fabricated capability badges.
promo.motion: Still unless explicitly commissioned as a separate clip.

audio.master: Optional original mono/stereo 48kHz WAV master with conservative headroom.
audio.safe_zone: No speech, recognizable music, startling peaks or hidden alerts; semantic feedback also visible.
audio.budget: Cue target <=80 KiB encoded; ambient bed <=2 MiB.
audio.motion: Separate opt-in playback; respect mute; never autoplay with a theme.

motion.master: Declarative motion token/timeline and code example, not a mandatory video asset.
motion.safe_zone: No scroll hijack, changing hit targets, flashing or state encoded only by motion.
motion.budget: No extra rendering library without measured need.
motion.motion: Use the durations and resource precedence in ../AMBIENCE.md.

sample.master: Original public-safe controlled sample set; target 1024px images with documented shared anchors.
deliverables: Manifest of roles and intended comparisons
Example-only captions and any actual execution receipts separately
sample.safe_zone: Original adult characters where present; no copyrighted franchise, private input or implied model qualification.
sample.budget: Lazy thumbnails <=60 KiB each; masters outside app bundle.
sample.motion: Stills unless the individual request explicitly asks for a recorded sequence.
